item.title: REF 0.2.0
item.description:
• Reference sets: drop several songs on Reference to compare your mix with their average. The charts shade the range the songs span, and you can save a set to use again.
  • Updates no longer pop up over your DAW. An Update button shows at the top of the REF window instead.
  • With Install updates automatically on, Restart to Update installs a downloaded update straight away.
